# Pocket Drop

> Send QOR by link to someone with no wallet. Their browser creates a Pocket: a smart account on QoreChain that only an ML-DSA-87 (post-quantum) key can move. Diana testnet only (EVM chain id 9800); QOR there has no monetary value. MIT license.

Live app: https://pocket-drop.vercel.app (Send, Receive, Pocket, Proof)
Relayer API: https://pocket-drop-api.vercel.app (/api/health, /api/stats, /api/qday)
Judge path: /qday (published classical keys of five bait Pockets, attacked hourly by our own bot), then /receive, then /judges.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): story, 60-second judge path, labelled numbers, claim checks, addresses, custody, credits
- [Audit](docs/AUDIT.md): QCAI Stage 1 (82), Stage 2 (78), Stage 3 on v5 (85), Stage 4 on v5.1 (82), Stage 5 on v5.2 (78, `QCAIA-1795664336974-576A1865`); v5.2 is current ([docs/V5_2.md](docs/V5_2.md)). The last three runs scored 85, 82 and 78 while the code got stricter; every finding has a verdict and tests (see [Stage 5 triage](docs/audit/stage5/QCAI_V5_2_TRIAGE.md)). Every pqcVerify/pqcKeyStatus call site is documented
- [Threat model](docs/THREAT_MODEL.md): assets, adversaries, mitigations, residual risk
- [Live results](contracts-v4/LIVE_RESULTS.md): every live step and attack on Diana, with tx hashes
- [Known issues](contracts-v4/KNOWN_ISSUES.md): limits we know about
- [Q-Day feasibility](docs/qday/FEASIBILITY.md): why a Pocket survives a leaked classical key
- [AI usage](AI_USAGE.md): what people did and what was AI-assisted

## Code

- [contracts-v4/src](contracts-v4/src): PocketVault, PocketFactory, PocketRouter, PocketDrop, DropPool, PqcLib (precompile wrappers), PqGuard
- [contracts-v4/test](contracts-v4/test): Foundry unit, fuzz and invariant tests
- [contracts-v4/deployments/diana.json](contracts-v4/deployments/diana.json): deployed addresses and recorded runs
- [backend](backend): relayer API (Vercel functions)
- [frontend](frontend): React app, Playwright specs, evidence, scripts/reverify.mjs

## Key facts

- Precompiles: pqcVerify at 0x0A01, pqcKeyStatus at 0x0A02
- Current (v5.2 PROD) PocketRouter 0xe0a2679ae760a843880489c8cf8da15c00559a88, PocketFactory 0x8aa57c26fb2ce4389c7732ab7876265dbb9e5278, PocketDrop 0xf0103854937897d6d117f947046d53fbc66a2639, DropPool 0xab3ac2fedb07c1e419ea86f41d49d417dd10dbf9. Earlier generations stay deployed; see README.
- Relayer 0xF6e6fb2d33Bef3043682658E2b69F3a2F8616cCD (qor17mn0ktfnhmesgd5zvk8zk60n5tuxzmxdc8ymnl): pays gas only, through a hybrid MsgCrossVMCall (secp256k1 + ML-DSA-87). Its ECDSA-only EVM window is closed. A user can also relay a signed call through their own short window scoped to the router.
- Explorer: https://explore.qore.network/tx/<hash>
